next_step: VPC topology deep-dive with Nyx infra + provide Private pricing for BYOK KMS integration
notes:
Quick summary: Nyx is a mid-to-large fintech building a customer support + fraud triage stack. Primary interest is Redwood Private (VPC) deployment with strict EU/NA data residency controls and KMS BYOK. They are in parallel PoC talks with Anthropic and a managed on-prem vendor; security is the gating factor.

Qualification notes (high level):
- Decision makers: CTO (L. Moreno), Head of Infra (G. Chen), Legal (procurement lead: R. Patel). AE intro call 2026-01-15.
- Current infra: multi-account AWS, primary regions us-east-1 and eu-west-1; strict cross-region replication rules.
- Data classification: PII + transaction traces -> cannot leave region for storage or audit logs.
- Compliance must-haves: SOC2 Type II + ISO27001 evidence, SAML SSO, enterprise KMS (AWS KMS with HSM/BYOK), 7+ year audit log retention or export to customer SIEM.

Architecture fit notes (from 2026-03-02 technical call):
- Preferred topology: Redwood Private in customer's VPC (Redwood control plane in a separate management VPC). They prefer either VPC peering/Transit Gateway or AWS PrivateLink endpoints.
- Inbound: zero inbound except from customer-managed subnets and an authenticated private endpoint (no public ELB). They want mTLS for service-to-service.
- Outbound: only to customer logging/SIEM endpoints and KMS. Egress must be restricted via NAT in customer account; no internet egress for model payloads.
- Subnet layout: dedicated private subnets for model hosts, separate subnets for management and secrets. Support for single-az testing then multi-az for HA.
- Routing: prefer VPC endpoints for S3, KMS, CloudWatch -> all logs pushed to customer-owned S3/CloudWatch/CloudTrail.
- KMS integration: BYOK required; customer wants HSM-backed key in their account; Redwood must accept EKM-style key wrapping or cross-account grant. Need design doc for key provisioning flow.
- Audit logging: must stream inference request/response metadata (no raw PII) to customer CloudWatch/Elasticsearch with tamper-evident chain; retention policy + export hooks.
- Residency: model weights allowed in eu-west-1 for EU traffic only; tokens must not cross region for EU-scoped requests.

Performance / SLAs:
- Targets: p95 latency for chat < 350ms on typical prompts; throughput target ~150 concurrent chat sessions (burst to 400).
- Cost sensitivity: mid (willing to pay premium for BYOK + dedicated capacity), wants cost estimate for reserved pool vs burst on Redwood Dedicated.

Security review status & timeline:
- 2026-02-18: initial security questionnaire submitted (linked).
- 2026-02-25: SOC2 artifact request raised; Redwood provided SOC2 summary and pen test summary.
- 2026-03-02: architecture call with infra + security (Fireflies ff_20260302_4478). Agreed POC scope: 2-week private deployment in eu-west-1 with BYOK + logging integration.
- Outstanding: KMS grant flow, legal review of data residency SLA, proof of isolation for multi-tenant control plane.

POC scope & success criteria (agreed):
- Deploy private Redwood runtime into Nyx dev AWS account in eu-west-1.
- Implement KMS BYOK, validate key rotation and encryption-at-rest.
- Configure log streaming to Nyx SIEM and demonstrate tamper-evidence.
- Meet latency p95 < 350ms for defined prompt set.
- Demonstrate routing/fallback: main model + quantized fallback for cost spikes.

Quotes & call snippets:
- "We cannot allow inference data to be stored outside EU for EU customers." - L. Moreno (CTO).
- "BYOK is non-negotiable for production." - G. Chen (Head of Infra).

Next steps (short):
- Send detailed VPC topology diagram + recommended CIDR allocation (action: Ravi).
- Draft KMS integration steps + required IAM policy snippets (action: SE).
- Legal/Procurement to produce redlines for data residency SLA by 2026-03-22.
- Schedule hands-on POC kickoff week of 2026-03-28.

Blocked by:
- Customer legal needs explicit SLA for data-in-region + audit log retention.
- Nyx security team requires an architectural diagram showing no outbound model weight transfer outside region.

Attachments and references:
- Security questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/nyx-security-review
- Pricing deck stub: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nyx-pricing-deck
